_readme: THE CONVERGENCE RUN (stage 2d, 2026-10-27): the 1 km stone of impact_telescope.json, the spin-up from half an hour before it to 1.5 h after, the departure at the impact and 300 km from it toward the anchor every sim-minute; once with the patch at the rank its lip needs over eight cells (2^7, 1.3 km) and once one rank finer (--set water.swe.patchCellsPerLip=16: 2^6, 650 m). If the train's amplitude at 300 km stands with the rank, the loss across the ocean is the physics of a hole to the bed collapsing; if it grows, the scheme's dissipation at the collapse.
